name: CloudHQ FRA Campus Offenbach
notes: Official CloudHQ campus page: two 56 MW critical IT-load buildings, fully permitted, powered by on-site 110 kV substation; city page describes ~112 MW IT load and 172 MW connected load.

name: CloudHQ FRA7 Campus Offenbach (Kettelerstrasse/Akzo Nobel)
notes: Official CloudHQ page lists FRA7 in Offenbach with 90 MW total critical IT load, development planned to begin 2027, service 2029; trade press reports ~93 MW and earliest operation 2027/2028.

name: Vantage Frankfurt I / FRA1 Campus Offenbach
notes: Official Vantage materials place Frankfurt I campus at Goethering 27, 63067 Offenbach am Main; campus described as 55-56 MW critical IT capacity.

name: maincubes FRA01 Offenbach
notes: maincubes lists FRA01 as in operation with 6 MW capacity; PeeringDB confirms address Goethering 29, Offenbach. Capacity B-grade (marketing).

name: Rheingau-Taunus-Kreis county-owned data center, Bad Schwalbach
notes: County privacy page states the district website is hosted in the county's own data center at Bad Schwalbach. No public capacity figure found.

name: Vogelsbergkreis district administration data center geothermal cooling
notes: DataCenter-Insider reported Vogelsbergkreis district administration installed geothermal cooling for server racks in its Landratsamt data center. No commercial/hyperscale project found.

name: Bad Vilbel-Massenheim Datacenter
notes: Wetteraukreis handed over the building permit for Bad Vilbel's first data center in Massenheim; planned IT area ~7,200 sqm, electrical connection 30 MVA, IT load 21 MW.

name: Karben-Rendel / Schultheisenwiese data center
developer: BlackRock Real Estate and Kauri CAB
notes: IZ Research summary identifies Karben-Rendel project with up to 33 MW IT load by BlackRock Real Estate and Kauri CAB; municipal planning documents for B-Plan Nr. 244 Schultheisenwiese reference Rechenzentrum planning; data center to be built on former nursery site outside Rendel.

name: firstcolo FRA7 Rosbach vor der Hoehe
notes: firstcolo ground-breaking in Rosbach 2026-06-15 (~EUR250m investment); SPIE says FRA7 designed for 16 MW IT load, completion by end of 2028; marketing also describes 24 MW total, so 16 MW IT load recorded conservatively.

name: Colt DCS Frankfurt 4 and Frankfurt 5, Wiesbaden
notes: Colt DCS secured a Wiesbaden site east of central Frankfurt for Frankfurt 4 and 5; the two sites contribute to 63 MW IT power.

name: WiTCOM DataCenter services / DataCenter 2
developer: WiTCOM Wiesbadener Informations- und Telekommunikations GmbH
notes: City/municipal company pages describe WiTCOM as offering data center and colocation services in Wiesbaden; DataCenterMap identifies WiTCOM DataCenter 2 (est. 1999). No public MW capacity.

name: You Logic AG certified data center, Wiesbaden
notes: You Logic states it provides DATEV hosting on dedicated and virtual servers in a certified data center in Wiesbaden. No public capacity figure.

name: Lunecon Rechenzentrum Westerstede
notes: Lunecon official pages list Rechenzentrum services from Westerstede (Danziger Str. 6, 26655 Westerstede); no public capacity figure.

name: OMG.DE / Emsnet Rechenzentrum Aurich-Ostfriesland
notes: OMG.DE/Emsnet official pages state they operate their own data center at the Aurich-Ostfriesland site, offering hosting, vServer, rackspace and server housing; no capacity figure.

name: Volkswagen Financial Services Braunschweig-Rautheim data center
notes: CIO.de reported VW Financial Services put its third Braunschweig data center into operation after a two-year build; investment ~EUR65m, over 2,000 sqm, expansion option to 5,000 sqm.

name: IBM Rechenzentrum Braunschweig
notes: Köster Bau project reference documents construction of an IBM data center in Braunschweig meeting high EMV/intrusion/fire-protection standards; C-grade construction-company reference (no public capacity/status details).

name: Rheinmetall Unterluess central data center
notes: Topping-out 2022 for modular high-security central group data center at Rheinmetall's Unterluess site (Landkreis Celle); sized for several thousand servers; commissioned by end-2022.

name: Rheinmetall Hermannsburg data center
notes: Second Rheinmetall data center at Hermannsburg (~15 km from Unterluess, Landkreis Celle), commissioning targeted Q1 2023; both buildings mid-double-digit millions EUR.

name: RZ-OM Cloppenburg data center capacity expansion
notes: Company history: expanded its data center capacities at the Cloppenburg site in 2024 after WebServ-IT transferred its data center; modernization and central monitoring.

name: Garrel energy and industry park IT campus
notes: German Datacenter Association partner profile quotes Garrel's mayor welcoming data center industry interest in an IT campus tied to the Garrel-Ost energy/industry park; municipal push to develop the park.

name: Sylatex Cuxhaven virtualized data center
notes: Company site states Sylatex operates a fully virtualized data center at its Cuxhaven location for cloud storage, backups, databases, DMS applications and hosted IT environments; no capacity.

name: Stadt Delmenhorst municipal data center
notes: City portal imprint states the portal is processed in the data center of the City of Delmenhorst; no further facility details or capacity; C-grade weak evidence.

name: Rohwerder Datasystems Rechenzentrum Delmenhorst
notes: Company official page states IT service and data center for companies in Delmenhorst (Rechenzentrum, Lizenzen und Hardware aus einer Hand); no public capacity figure.

name: dc2share Wagenfeld green data center
developer: dc2share GmbH & Co. KG / Wagenfelder Energie Grundstuecksgesellschaft
notes: First project on former Patriot military site in Wagenfeld-Foerlingen (Landkreis Diepholz), powered mainly by local renewables; building application targeted Q4 2026, initial scale 5-10 MW growing over ten years.

name: Deutsche Telekom edge data center at Volkswagen Emden port terminal
notes: DCD reported Deutsche Telekom deployed a 5G network and edge data center at Volkswagen's Emden port terminal hosting the Unikie Marshalling Solution for the AutoLog autonomous car logistics project.

name: Landkreis Emsland Meppen municipal data center
notes: Construction started on a new municipal data center addition at the Meppen district administration building; completion expected end-2027; total cost ~EUR3.4m (EUR2.24m building + ~EUR1.2m technical equipment); no power capacity disclosed.

name: DiaServ Gifhorn data center
notes: DiaServ site lists a Rechenzentrum in Gifhorn (Am Hagen 2, 38518 Gifhorn), over 5,000 users in service, ~300 supported sites; no capacity disclosed.
